pr_title: Fix for LPSPI Async with DMA
pr_comments:
Hi, since i'm also touching this (https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/61938). Actually, with current implementation, LPSPI + DMA is always a blocking call (there is a loop here https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/main/drivers/spi/spi_mcux_lpspi.c#L417-L418).

By calling `transceive_dma` with `asynchronous = true` and `cb != NULL`, the user callback function may still be called, but is after each DMA block finished (https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/main/drivers/spi/spi_mcux_lpspi.c#L279) which means data was just sent partly when user callback is reached, not the whole. Does this something that you expect?

issue_context.title: MCUX_LPSPI driver will fail to build if both CONFIG_SPI_MCUX_LPSPI_DMA and CONFIG_SPI_ASYNC are set.
issue_context.body:
**Describe the bug**
The MCUX_LPSPI driver will fail to build if a test/sample turns on both CONFIG_SPI_MCUX_LPSPI_DMA
and CONFIG_SPI_ASYNC. Since the transceive function inside the MCUX_LPSPI driver is discarded when
turning on CONFIG_SPI_MCUX_LPSPI_DMA, the Async API will be unable to call any functions while
both Kconfigs are set.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1.  Set both CONFIG_SPI_ASYNC and SPI_MCUX_LPSPI_DMA
2.  Ensure board has edma enabled as well as the proper dts spi nodes, slow and fast, for spi_loopback test.
3.  Attempt to build for spi_loopback test.

**Expected behavior**
Test should build.

**Impact**
If tested with mimxrt1064_evk the output is:
```
[104/142] Building C object zephyr/drivers/spi/CMakeFiles/drivers__spi.dir/spi_mcux_lpspi.c.obj
/home/emilio/zephyrproject/zephyr/drivers/spi/spi_mcux_lpspi.c: In function 'spi_mcux_transceive_async':
/home/emilio/zephyrproject/zephyr/drivers/spi/spi_mcux_lpspi.c:530:16: warning: implicit declaration of function 'transceive'; did you mean 'transceive_dma'? [-Wimplicit-function-declaration]
  530 |         return transceive(dev, spi_cfg, tx_bufs, rx_bufs, true, cb, userdata);

      |                ^~~~~~~~~~

      |                transceive_dma
[137/142] Linking C executable zephyr/zephyr_pre0.elf
FAILED: zephyr/zephyr_pre0.elf zephyr/zephyr_pre0.map /home/emilio/zephyrproject/build/zephyr/zephyr_pre0.map 
```
